performance.collecting: Collecting samples — first one in a few seconds…

crashLoop.title: Server is crash-looping
crashLoop.body: Docker has restarted the container {n} time(s) and the last exit code was {code}. The server boots, fails, and Docker brings it back up. Usually caused by an engine swap that left an incompatible world or mods on disk.

publicAccess.label: Public access
publicAccess.copyHint: Click to copy · navigate to Network to change
publicAccess.viaDirect: Direct port forwarding from the public IP
publicAccess.viaPlayit: Tunnelled through playit.gg — no port forwarding needed
publicAccess.viaDomain: Custom domain — DNS records on your provider
publicAccess.noPublicIp: We couldn't detect a public IP (CGNAT? offline?). Configure Playit or set an override.
publicAccess.noPlayitHost: Playit hostname not set — paste it from your playit.gg dashboard.
publicAccess.agentNotRunning: Playit agent isn't running — start it from the Network page.
publicAccess.noTunnel: Playit agent connected but no tunnel configured on playit.gg yet.

console.title: Console
console.placeholder: list / say hello / op user / save-all  (Tab = autocomplete · ↑/↓ = history)
console.autocompleteHint: Tab to accept · ↑/↓ to navigate · Esc to dismiss
console.scrollToBottomHint: Scroll to the most recent line
console.copyHint: Copy the full console buffer to the clipboard
console.copyEmpty: Console is empty — nothing to copy

files.title: Files
files.subtitle: Edit configs, drop in mods and plugins, manage worlds.
files.emptySubtitle: Drop files here, or click Upload

fileEditor.title: Edit
fileEditor.binaryDescription: Use the download button to fetch it as bytes.
fileEditor.tooLargeDescription: Files above 5 MiB can't be opened in the editor — download instead.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Tweak server.properties from a typed UI — no more raw editing.
settings.restartHint: Most changes apply on next server restart.

motd.label: Server MOTD
motd.help: Message shown in the server list (max 60 chars). § color codes work.

server-port.label: Server port
server-port.help: TCP port the server binds to (default 25565).

server-ip.label: Bind IP
server-ip.help: Leave blank to bind to every interface.

allow-flight.label: Allow flight
allow-flight.help: Allow plugins/mods to grant flight without kicking the player.

force-gamemode.label: Force default gamemode
force-gamemode.help: Reset returning players to the default gamemode on join.

level-name.label: World name
level-name.help: Folder name for the main world.

online-mode.label: Online mode
online-mode.help: Verify accounts with Mojang. Turn off only for offline LAN.

white-list.label: Whitelist
white-list.help: Only allow listed players to join.

enforce-whitelist.label: Enforce whitelist
enforce-whitelist.help: Kick non-whitelisted players that are already online.

op-permission-level.label: Op permission level
op-permission-level.help: 1 = bypass spawn protection · 2 = singleplayer cheats · 3 = multiplayer cheats · 4 = full.

enforce-secure-profile.label: Enforce secure profile
enforce-secure-profile.help: Reject 1.19+ clients without a Mojang-signed chat key.

prevent-proxy-connections.label: Prevent proxy connections
prevent-proxy-connections.help: Block connections that look like they come through a proxy.

mods.title: Mods & plugins
mods.subtitle: Search Modrinth and Hangar, install with one click, manage what's on disk.

unsupported.title: This server doesn't accept mods or plugins
unsupported.desc: {type} servers run vanilla Minecraft. Switch to Paper, Forge, Fabric, NeoForge, Spigot, Purpur, Folia or Quilt to install mods and plugins.

manual.title: Upload your own .jar / .mrpack
manual.subtitle: For mods or plugins not on Modrinth/Hangar. We inspect the archive's metadata, tell you if it matches your server, then drop it in the right folder.
manual.pickHint: .jar (mod / plugin) · .mrpack (Modrinth modpack) · .zip (CurseForge serverpack) — up to 1 GB
manual.name: Name
manual.pickKindPrompt: No metadata found inside — pick where this file should go:
manual.warnNote: Your MC version isn't in the declared range — the mod may refuse to load.

mods.searchHint: Type at least 2 characters to search.
mods.confirmUninstallDesc: The .jar will be removed from disk. The server picks this up on next restart.
mods.installedEmpty: Nothing installed via the marketplace yet
mods.installedEmptyHint: Browse mods/plugins, click install — your installs land here.
mods.untrackedHint: These were not installed through hostcraft (file-manager upload, restored from backup, …). They run alongside your installed mods/plugins.

compat.mismatchTooltip: This project doesn't list {v} as supported. Open it on the source to check available versions.
compat.unknownTooltip: This project doesn't list any Minecraft version — install will likely fail.

mods.modpackInstallDisabled: Modpack install isn't supported yet. Open the project to follow the recommended setup.
mods.strictTooltip: Show only projects that explicitly support Minecraft {v}.
mods.idleDesc: Type at least 2 characters to find {source} mods, plugins or modpacks. Compatible installs only — incompatible projects show but can't be installed.
mods.emptyDesc: Nothing matched "{q}". Try a shorter query or different keywords.

conflictAdvisory.title: Heads up — individual mods can conflict
conflictAdvisory.body: Mods aren't sandboxed: two installs can collide on shared classes, IDs or version ranges. When a curated modpack matches your need, prefer it — its author has tested the combination.

toasts.installedUnverified: Hash not verified — provider didn't supply one

icon.title: Server icon
icon.subtitle: Pick a preset, upload your own, or reset to the default.
icon.uploadHint: Auto-resized to {size}×{size} · max {max} KB · PNG / JPEG / WebP
icon.resetDesc: The default Minecraft icon will be used until you set another.
icon.restartHint: Minecraft picks up the icon on the next server start.

players.title: Players
players.subtitle: Manage who can join, who has admin powers.

whitelist.title: Whitelist
whitelist.subtitle: Only listed players can join when whitelist is enforced.

ops.title: Operators
ops.subtitle: Players with elevated permissions on the server.
ops.levelHint: 1 = bypass spawn · 2 = singleplayer cheats · 3 = multiplayer cheats · 4 = full

backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Snapshot your world before risky changes — restore on demand.

kinds.full_help: Compress everything in /data including mods, plugins, configs.
kinds.compressionNote: The .tar.gz output is typically 30–60 % smaller than the raw size shown above.

backups.emptyHint: Click "Create backup" to start your first one.
backups.confirmRestoreDesc: The server will be stopped, the data directory replaced, and the server restarted. This cannot be undone.
backups.uploadPickDesc: Pick a destination to upload this backup to:
backups.uploadPickHint: Type the destination name in the prompt to confirm.

toasts.noDestinationDesc: Create one in the Off-site destinations tab first.

destinations.subtitle: S3-compatible buckets where backups can be mirrored off-site.
destinations.endpointHelp: Full URL including https:// — e.g. https://s3.us-east-005.backblazeb2.com
destinations.secretPlaceholderKeep: Leave empty to keep current secret
destinations.emptyHint: Add one above to mirror backups to S3, Backblaze B2, R2, etc.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.subtitle: Cron-driven jobs: restarts, backups, RCON commands.
schedules.emptyHint: Click "New schedule" to automate restarts, backups or RCON commands.

kinds.restartHelp: Gracefully stop and start the Minecraft server.
kinds.backupFullHelp: Compress the whole data dir including mods, plugins, configs.
kinds.rconHelp: Send an arbitrary command via RCON (e.g. "say hi", "save-all").

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.subtitle: Audit trail of panel and server events.

network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Public access, custom domain, additional ports.

publicAccess.title: Public access
publicAccess.subtitle: How players reach your server from the internet.
publicAccess.playitHostHint: Copy this from your Playit agent dashboard. It's permanent — safe to use as a CNAME target.
publicAccess.playitHostHintManaged: The hostname is owned by playit.gg — this field is just a mirror used for the DNS preview. Change it on playit.gg to change the real tunnel address.
publicAccess.playitNotSet: Hostname not set yet (start the agent or paste it from playit.gg)

direct.label: Direct (port forwarding)
direct.help: Open port 25565 on your router. Best latency.

playit_guided.label: Playit.gg (guided)
playit_guided.help: Run a Playit agent yourself, paste the hostname here. No port forwarding needed.

playit_managed.label: Playit.gg (managed)
playit_managed.help: Hostcraft runs the Playit agent for you in a sidecar container.

agent.secretStored: Secret saved — paste a new one to replace it
agent.secretHint: Get this from playit.gg → Account → Agent secrets. Stored encrypted, used to authenticate the sidecar with playit.gg.
agent.noLogs: No logs yet. The agent prints a claim URL on first boot if the secret hasn't been linked to a tunnel.
agent.noTunnelTitle: Secret valid, but no tunnel configured yet
agent.noTunnelBody: Your agent is connected to playit.gg but has 0 tunnels. Go to your playit.gg dashboard, create a Minecraft Java tunnel pointing to local address "minecraft:25565", then come back here — the hostname will auto-fill.
agent.refresh: I just added one — check now
agent.tunnelTargetLabel: Tunnel target — paste into playit.gg's Local IP / Port
agent.tunnelTargetHint: The agent shares the Minecraft container's network, so its localhost is the server. This never changes regardless of recreations, host OS, or your Docker network setup.

domain.title: Custom domain
domain.subtitle: Point a domain at your server. We generate the DNS records you need.
domain.label: Domain
domain.hint: Prefer a subdomain (e.g. mc.example.com). Apex domains don't support CNAME.
domain.recordsHint: Add these records at your DNS provider. Click any value to copy it.
domain.cantPreview: Set a domain and (when using Playit) a hostname to preview DNS records.

allocations.title: Allocations
allocations.subtitle: Extra ports for BlueMap, Geyser, voice chat, web maps…
allocations.confirmDeleteDesc: The port will be removed and the container recreated.

watchdog.title: Auto-restart watchdog
watchdog.subtitle: Restart the Minecraft server automatically when its container goes unhealthy.
watchdog.enabledHelp: When the container is unhealthy longer than the threshold below, we restart it.
watchdog.thresholdHelp: How long the container must be unhealthy before we restart it. 30–3600 s.
watchdog.maxHelp: Safety cap to avoid restart loops. 1–20.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.subtitle: Server type, version, memory, JVM flags. Changes recreate the container.
runtime.warningDescription: Applying these changes will gracefully stop the Minecraft container, recreate it with the new env, and start it again. Connected players will be disconnected.

TYPE.label: Server type
TYPE.help: Vanilla, Paper, Forge, Fabric… Plugins (Bukkit API) and mods (Forge/Fabric) are not interchangeable.

VERSION.label: Minecraft version
VERSION.help: Use LATEST to track the newest stable, or pin an exact build (e.g. 1.21.4).

MEMORY.label: Memory
MEMORY.help: Heap size for the JVM, e.g. 4G, 6G, 8192M.

USE_AIKAR_FLAGS.label: Aikar's flags
USE_AIKAR_FLAGS.help: Apply the well-known JVM flags by Aikar tuned for Minecraft. Recommended.

JVM_OPTS.label: JVM_OPTS
JVM_OPTS.help: Extra JVM flags. Power-user — leave empty unless you know what you're doing.

JVM_XX_OPTS.label: JVM_XX_OPTS
JVM_XX_OPTS.help: Extra -XX flags. Combined with Aikar's flags when both are set.

JAVA.label: Java runtime
JAVA.help: Picks the itzg/minecraft-server image variant — independent from your engine (Paper/Forge/…) and MC version. Auto picks the right Java for the requested MC.
JAVA.tooNew: Newer than Minecraft {mc}'s recommended Java {recommended}. The server boots, but native libraries bundled with older mods (spark's async-profiler is a frequent offender) may segfault. Pick the recommended ★ option for stable.

risky.title: Major change detected
risky.description: Changing server type or version can break worlds, mods and plugins. We strongly recommend running a full backup first.
risky.backupFailed: Safety backup failed — apply was cancelled

engineSwap.title: Engine swap: {old} → {new}
engineSwap.description: The data dir is full of {old}-specific files (mods/plugins, world data, configs, caches) that won't load on a {new} server. We recommend a clean reset — only your server.properties, ops, whitelist and icon are kept. Recover from the safety backup if you need anything else. Choose to keep at your own risk if you know what you're doing.

cleanInstall.title: Clean install
cleanInstall.subtitle: Wipe the data dir and let the server bootstrap fresh. Useful when the server is stuck in a crash loop after an engine swap.
cleanInstall.description: Everything in the data dir except server.properties, ops, whitelist, banned lists, usercache, eula and the server icon will be deleted. The container is recreated from scratch. This cannot be undone.
cleanInstall.hint: Take a full backup first if you might want to recover anything.

world.title: World map
world.subtitle: Live web map of your worlds, powered by BlueMap.

unsupported.title: World map isn't available on this engine
unsupported.body: BlueMap runs on Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Forge, NeoForge, Fabric and Quilt. Your server is currently {type} — switch to one of those from the Runtime page to enable the world map.

setup.title: Set up BlueMap
setup.subtitle: We install the right BlueMap build for your engine + Minecraft version, open port 8100 on the server, and embed the live map right here.
setup.feature1: Realtime 3D world view rendered as you play
setup.feature2: Nether, end and custom dimensions supported
setup.feature3: Web app embeds in this panel — also shareable as a URL
setup.confirmBody: We'll download the latest BlueMap build for {loader} on Minecraft {mc}, open port 8100, and restart the server. Existing worlds keep their data — BlueMap renders tiles in the background as chunks load.
setup.note: First-time rendering can take a few minutes per chunk loaded — empty until your world starts being played.

installed.tilesNote: Tiles are generated lazily as chunks get loaded — keep the server running and visit your world for the map to fill in.

toasts.installedDesc: Server is restarting with port 8100 published. The map will appear once it's back up.

console.title: Live console
console.description: xterm.js, command/reply correlation, error/warn/info filters and full-screen come online in Phase 1.

mods.title: Unified mod & plugin marketplace
mods.description: Modrinth, Hangar, Spigot and CurseForge in one search, with version-aware dependency resolution and rollback. The headline feature — landing in Phase 2.

players.title: Players
players.description: Op, kick, ban and whitelist from a clean web UI — visual editors land in Phase 1.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Local snapshots, scheduled jobs, and off-site targets (S3 / B2 / Backblaze / Google Drive) ship in Phase 1.

world.title: World map
world.description: One-click BlueMap or Squaremap install, with the panel reverse-proxying the tiles — even when the server is hibernated. Phase 3.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Visual editors for server.properties, ops, whitelist; JVM args; multi-JDK selector; account & 2FA. Phase 1.
